reference_findings.diagnosis: Symptomatic multivessel obstructive coronary artery disease with diabetes and CKD; revascularization strategy requires individualized multidisciplinary review.
reference_findings.risk_assessment: High risk / complex revascularization discussion; qualitative simulation label only, not a validated score.

investigation_reports.ecg: Sinus rhythm; nonspecific ST-T changes; no acute ST-elevation pattern.
investigation_reports.laboratory_panel: Serial hs-cTn without significant rise/fall in the fictional stable presentation. Hb 12.1 g/dL; creatinine 1.5 mg/dL; eGFR reported as 44 mL/min/1.73 m2 (synthetic); potassium 4.5 mmol/L; HbA1c 8.2%; LDL-C 118 mg/dL.
investigation_reports.echocardiography: LVEF 48%; mild global hypokinesis; no acute mechanical complication.
investigation_reports.coronary_or_other_imaging: Reference angiogram: diffuse calcified disease with ~75% proximal LAD, ~80% mid LCx/large OM, and ~80% proximal RCA lesions; left main 20%; flow TIMI 3 in all three territories. Synthetic SYNTAX-like complexity descriptor is “high complexity”; no formal score is calculated.
investigation_reports.initial_vitals: HR 78 bpm; BP 136/78 mmHg; RR 17/min; SpO2 97%; afebrile; no acute shock features.
investigation_reports.not_supplied: Any test not explicitly listed is not ordered/not available; it must not be interpreted as normal.

history.chief_complaint: Progressive exertional dyspnoea and chest tightness over six weeks, now occurring with minimal activity.
history.history_of_present_illness: Symptoms reproducible with exertion, relieved by rest. No persistent rest pain in the initial snapshot; symptoms have progressed.
relevant_history: Chronic kidney disease stage 3 in fictional history
medication_reconciliation: Fictional medication list incomplete; assess adherence and drug interactions

pathway_review.label: Heart Team discussion comparing medical therapy, PCI feasibility and CABG suitability
pathway_review.reason: Anatomical complexity, diabetes, LV function, renal risk and patient goals all matter.

pathway_review.label: Proceed with a broad multivessel PCI plan without reviewing complexity or renal risk
pathway_review.reason: Skips key individualized planning and contrast/renal-risk review.

pathway_review.label: Optimize guideline-directed chronic coronary disease management and reassess symptoms
pathway_review.reason: Medical therapy is essential; whether it is sufficient depends on complete review and symptoms/anatomy.

reference_findings.safety_review: Renal function/contrast exposure planning, anemia/bleeding review, diabetes management, medication reconciliation, informed consent and discussion of PCI versus surgical options are required in the educational checklist.
reference_findings.simulated_clinical_course: Reference branch: case is referred to a Heart Team decision node rather than rewarding a single automatic intervention. Learner compares expected benefits, risks and unknowns.
learning_objectives: Describe disease in each major vessel and lesion complexity.
Explain why diabetes/multivessel anatomy can change the revascularization discussion.
reference_findings.review_note: Synthetic scenario. Clinical values and pathway labels require qualified interventional cardiology review before deployment. Educational use only; not real-patient guidance.
